parameters.query: =SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS otp_active FROM workspace.agentic_support.verification_codes WHERE customer_id = '{{ $("Fetch Customer from Salesforce").first().json.Customer_Id__c }}' AND purpose = 'email_change' AND used = 0 AND expires_at > current_timestamp()

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: An active email-change verification code already exists. Would you like me to send a new code? Reply yes to resend or no to use the existing code.

parameters.query: =MERGE INTO workspace.agentic_support.verification_codes AS target USING (SELECT '{{ $json.customerId }}' AS customer_id, '{{ $json.code }}' AS code, 'email_change' AS purpose, current_timestamp() + INTERVAL 5 MINUTES AS expires_at) AS source ON target.customer_id = source.customer_id AND target.purpose = source.purpose WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.code = source.code, target.expires_at = source.expires_at, target.used = 0 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (customer_id, code, purpose, expires_at, used) VALUES (source.customer_id, source.code, source.purpose, source.expires_at, 0)
